label: scam
description: Asks the applicant to pay a registration or processing fee before starting work
text: Pay a small registration fee to activate your job offer and receive your starter kit before you begin work.

label: scam
description: Requests bank account or card details early in the hiring process
text: Send us your bank account details so we can process your first salary advance before your official joining date.

label: scam
description: Uses urgency and scarcity to pressure a quick decision
text: Limited seats available, act now! This offer expires in 24 hours, apply immediately to secure your position.

label: scam
description: Promises unusually high pay for minimal or unspecified work
text: Earn $3000 per week working just two hours a day from home, no experience or interview required.

label: scam
description: Hiring conducted entirely through a personal messaging app with no formal interview
text: Contact our recruiter directly on WhatsApp or Telegram to get hired instantly, no resume or interview needed.

label: scam
description: Uses a free email provider while claiming to represent a large, well-known company
text: We are hiring on behalf of a Fortune 500 company, reply to our recruiter at hr.jobs2024@gmail.com to proceed.

label: scam
description: Asks candidates to purchase equipment or a starter kit from the company before onboarding
text: You must purchase your work laptop and starter kit directly from us before we can activate your employee account.

label: legit
description: Standard corporate job posting describing responsibilities and required qualifications
text: We are seeking a qualified candidate with relevant experience to join our team and contribute to ongoing projects.

label: legit
description: Directs applicants to a formal company careers page or HR portal
text: Please apply through our official careers page by submitting your resume and cover letter for review by our HR team.

label: legit
description: Describes a standard multi-stage interview process
text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first-round phone screen followed by an in-person or video interview panel.

label: legit
description: Mentions standard benefits without requiring any upfront payment
text: We offer a competitive salary, health benefits, and professional development opportunities for this full-time role.

label: legit
description: Specifies a clear, realistic salary range tied to experience level
text: The salary range for this position is $60,000 to $75,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
